name: @ars/server
description: A R S Assistant FastAPI RAG backend

scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ -x ./venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then ./venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -x ./venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then ./venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi'
scripts.ingest: sh -c 'if [ -x ./venv/bin/python ]; then ./venv/bin/python ingest.py; else python3 ingest.py; fi'
